name: fmcg-order-advisor
description: FMCG distributor order advisor: order mix, replenishment cadence, manufacturer rebate thresholds and inventory-risk checks

displayDescription.en: Turns shipment history, channel inventory and manufacturer policy into an executable order list, avoiding both stockout and overstock
displayDescription.zh: 把历史出货、渠道库存与厂商政策折算成可执行的订货清单，既不断货也不压货

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 下个月要开订货会了，帮我按上个季度的出货和现在的渠道库存，算一下各品类该订多少，顺便看看返利档位怎么拿最划算。
defaultInitPrompt.en: The order fair is next month. Based on last quarter's shipments and current channel inventory, help me size the order by category and hit the best rebate tier.

quickPrompts.zh: 下个月要开订货会了，帮我按上个季度的出货和现在的渠道库存，算一下各品类该订多少，顺便看看返利档位怎么拿最划算。
quickPrompts.en: Help me size next month's order by category and choose the best rebate tier.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我判断这批特价政策要不要接，接多少合适
quickPrompts.en: Should I take this special-price policy, and how much?

quickPrompts.zh: 看看我现在的订货结构有没有压货风险
quickPrompts.en: Review my order mix for overstock risk
